author: Athul Prem
question: Do the stronger/weaker reflection groups persist under one archived h100/h80 z4 global in-plane increment at 0.1 GHz?

physical_inputs.material: Nominal fixed-property Ge; not measured mK/4 K material data

independent_source_review.scope: Exact historical/current source exceptions, original mesh/K/M/section/mode and trace identities, graph/index admission, cached export provenance; corrected original 2048-element assembly label. No numerical test repetition.

final_affected_data_review.reviewer: point_verification with independent small-matrix algebra check
final_affected_data_review.scope: Independent 4x4 R/T and D reconstruction from original complex CSVs, signed/gauge-aligned differences, relative reflection, report/ledger identity and scientific limits. No body-array load, repeated solve, full replay or test run.

initial_ci_failure.cause: The synthetic restore fixture retained an unresolved Windows temporary-directory alias, while artifact links were canonical. Production read_inputs already resolves the directory.
initial_ci_failure.correction: Resolve only the fixture temporary root; production runner, replay code and all scientific outputs are unchanged.

corrected_fixture_tests.scope: Affected runner fixtures only; no repeated full local suite or production computation.

fixture_delta_review.scope: One canonical temporary-directory line and two explanatory comments; original mapping/mode/rejection assertions retained. Production runner/verifier hashes unchanged.

coherent_left_incidence.scope: Left-incident propagating reflection and transmission in the original SAFE basis

in_plane_comparison.author: Athul Prem

weak_reflection_diagnostic.floor_interpretation: Reporting guard only; no numerical noise bound or relative-accuracy gate.

in_plane_comparison.scope: One h100/h80 global in-plane increment at 0.1 GHz changes both lead interiors and the patterned region. Original end-plane phases are retained. Finite pair checks do not establish continuum or weak-reflection error bounds.

independent_replay_execution.author: Athul Prem
independent_replay_execution.measurement_scope: Observed launcher and numerical descendants; sampled peak, not an exact operating-system high-water mark.

transfer_totals.scope: All returned stage, solve and export artifacts; transfer manifests excluded; original input upload separate.

next_step.scope: Bounded question complete. Select the next claim-specific frequency or independent spatial check from the saved evidence and Athul roadmap before admitting resources; no automatic finer ladder or campaign.

athul_review.coherent_request: Implemented in accepted z6 and retained in z4/h100 independent replay without additional body solves.
athul_review.applied: Report absolute and relative reflection increments with a declared reporting floor; finite pair checks are not weak-signal uncertainty bounds.
